title: Harvard study: 403 US data centers, operational between May 2024 and April 2025, consumed more electricity in total than the state of Michigan in a single year (Molly Taft/Wired)
summary: Molly Taft / Wired: Harvard study: 403 US data centers, operational between May 2024 and April 2025, consumed more electricity in total than the state of Michigan in a single year — New Harvard research shows that data-center power demand is outstripping states—and that doesn't even include facilities with off-grid gas plants.
